summary.zh: 从事件流构建读模型与物化视图
summary.en: Build read models and materialized views from events

description.zh: 说明投影器如何订阅事件流并写入读库，涵盖重建、幂等、顺序处理和实时看板、搜索索引等场景，并给出查询性能优化的做法。适合实现 CQRS 读侧或为事件溯源系统补充查询能力时使用。
description.en: Shows how projectors subscribe to event streams and write read models, covering rebuilds, idempotency, ordering, live dashboards, and search indexes. Use it to implement the read side of CQRS or speed up queries in an event-sourced system.
